subject: general
question: When was the first ‘International Day of Yoga’ celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21 June 2015**.__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• International yoga day is celebrated every year** on 21 June**. 
 
• The date 21st June was suggested by Indian **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in his **UN** address.
 
• The date 21st June is very important because in the **northern hemisphere** it is the **longest day **and in the **southern hemisphere**, it is the **shortest day**.
